decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter is the flagship of the organic direction and builds directly on the firm's curing and seasoning know-how, so management can interpret its results and refine the variants.

Poultry mini salami snacks extend existing salami expertise into the growing organic snack segment; the snack format carries more market risk, but the related knowledge base supports adjustment rather than withdrawal.
The premium sharing salami line uses the firm's maturation and recipe capabilities, letting it absorb market feedback and trim or adapt variants instead of dropping the whole line.
Organic Fleischwurst is a classic boiled-sausage product squarely within the firm's traditional processing know-how and fits its organic expansion, so early results can be read and acted on easily.

Organic thinly sliced chicken breast in two flavours is newly launched and fits the organic and ingredient-conscious direction, and the firm's existing slicing and seasoning competence allows it to learn from early sales.
The organic herb-coated salami draws directly on the firm's in-house seasoning and curing expertise, so it is a low-risk extension that management can refine based on early feedback.
